name: Thank You Recap
summary: Turn your year's videos into a 16:9 "Thank you" recap Draft: a beat-cut intro, a held hero shot under a flickering year, and a salsa finale on bundled music.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/askAI, Draft setFrameSize and addMotionGraphic, and the host FileSystem and bundled ffmpeg (Runtime.runFFmpeg); no shell. Released-version compatibility is unverified, and the Windows pass has not run yet.

de.name: Thank You Rückblick
de.summary: Macht aus den Videos deines Jahres einen 16:9-Rückblick-Entwurf „Thank you“: ein beatgenauer Einstieg, eine Hauptaufnahme unter einer flackernden Jahreszahl und ein Salsa-Finale zur mitgelieferten Musik.

en.name: Thank You Recap
en.summary: Turn your year's videos into a 16:9 "Thank you" recap Draft: a beat-cut intro, a held hero shot under a flickering year, and a salsa finale on bundled music.

es.name: Resumen Thank You
es.summary: Convierte los vídeos de tu año en un borrador de resumen "Thank you" en 16:9: una intro cortada al ritmo, un plano principal bajo un año parpadeante y un final de salsa con la música incluida.

fr.name: Rétrospective Thank You
fr.summary: Transformez les vidéos de votre année en brouillon rétrospectif « Thank you » en 16:9 : une intro montée sur le rythme, un plan principal sous une année clignotante et un final salsa sur la musique fournie.

it.name: Recap Thank You
it.summary: Trasforma i video del tuo anno in una bozza recap "Thank you" in 16:9: un'intro a tempo, un'inquadratura principale sotto un anno lampeggiante e un finale salsa sulla musica inclusa.

ja.name: Thank You リキャップ
ja.summary: 1年分の動画から16:9の「Thank you」リキャップのドラフトを作成します。ビートに合わせたイントロ、点滅する年の下のメインショット、同梱の音楽に乗せたサルサのフィナーレで構成されます。

ko.name: Thank You Recap
ko.summary: 한 해의 영상으로 16:9 "Thank you" 리캡 Draft를 만듭니다. 비트에 맞춘 인트로, 깜빡이는 연도 아래 메인 샷, 함께 제공되는 음악 위의 살사 피날레로 구성됩니다.

pt.name: Retrospectiva Thank You
pt.summary: Transforme os vídeos do seu ano em um rascunho de retrospectiva "Thank you" em 16:9: uma abertura no ritmo, um plano principal sob um ano piscante e um final de salsa com a música incluída.

tr.name: Thank You Özeti
tr.summary: Yılınızın videolarını 16:9 bir "Thank you" özet taslağına dönüştürün: ritme göre kesilmiş bir giriş, yanıp sönen yılın altında ana çekim ve dahil edilen müzikle bir salsa finali.

zh.name: Thank You 年度回顾
zh.summary: 用一年的视频制作 16:9 的“Thank you”年度回顾草稿：卡点开场、闪烁年份下的主镜头，以及配上内置音乐的萨尔萨结尾。

inputs.label: Select hero video
inputs.hint: Held for about 6 seconds under THANK YOU and the year.

inputs.label: Select clips
inputs.hint: Cut fast to the music; fewer clips repeat at later moments.

prepare: One calm, wide video at least 6.1 seconds long for the hero shot
